scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && (npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web & wait)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run install-browsers --workspace e2e && npm run test --workspace e2e
scripts.test:ai: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run test:ai --workspace apps/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && node scripts/check-original.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs
